column1: #   <fixture> <expected oracle outcome> <script under scripts/ and its args, OUT = the fixture>
# Read by tools/oracle/fixtures.py (regenerates each fixture in place with
# llama.cpp's own gguf-py) and tools/oracle/parity.py (runs `frink parity
# --tokens 3,7,11,19,23,5 --decode-steps 32` on it and fails when the
# outcome differs from the one written here, in either direction). The
# outcomes are defined in tools/oracle/parity.py. A non-`match` row says
# why on its own line end; one naming an issue is a known divergence,
# not a pass. tests/oracle_manifest.rs fails if a fixture has no row.
arcee_gated_tiny                         both-fail                    make_arcee_fixture.py OUT --gated  # refusal evidence: ReluSqr is ungated, llama.cpp rejects the extra tensor too
cohere2_nowindow_tiny                    both-fail                    make_cohere2_fixture.py OUT --no-window  # refusal evidence: the window key is REQUIRED upstream
